newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia parliament orders two MPs to stand trial.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia parliament orders two MPs to stand trial.

text.p: Ethiopia's parliament lifted immunity from two MPs on Tuesday and ordered that they stand trial for alleged involvement in the 1977/78 Red Terror campaign.
Parliament announced the decision after its legal committee studied a summons for the MPs, Tamiru Defersha and Kusiya Tolombi, from the Special Prosecutor's office.

The prosecutor alleged they were involved in the execution of members of a Marxist group opposing the Dergue government of ousted dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam in Derasa and Gardula districts in the Southern People's Regional State.

Ethiopia has begun trials of 71 former officials of the Dergue for genocide and crimes against humanity during the Red Terror campaign against suspected Marxist opponents. They face the death penalty if convicted.
